formatted_question:
According to the opinion 'Williams v. GoAuto Insurance,' under strict adherence, Louisiana law imposed
(A) a notarization requirement for the APAC certification
(B) the same signature formalities discussed in Benitez
(C) no signature requirement
(D) a signed certification requirement
(E) an actual-receipt requirement for cancellation notices
option_a: a notarization requirement for the APAC certification
option_b: the same signature formalities discussed in Benitez
option_e: an actual-receipt requirement for cancellation notices
distractors: ["a signed certification requirement", "an actual-receipt requirement for cancellation notices", "the same signature formalities discussed in Benitez", "a notarization requirement for the APAC certification"]
fact: According to the opinion 'Williams v. GoAuto Insurance,' under strict adherence, Louisiana law imposed no signature requirement
